title: Trusted Trade — verifiable B2B buying agents
objective: Turn a professional kitchen's purchasing need into a fixed-price, stock-checked, policy-controlled quote and an auditable, idempotent buyer-approved simulated order; expose a vendor-neutral HTTP interchange model for eventual Valio Aimo connection.

capabilityUses.purpose: Scope a synthetic professional-kitchen purchasing request and verification goals; never authorize a supplier action.
Review the invented quote and audit data flow, idempotency and source provenance; no Aiven service is called.
Inspect synthetic refusal and replay traces for prompt-injection, stale-price and duplicate-order failure modes; no model evaluation is executed.
